notes.title: Patch released!
notes.notes:
We have released a new patch supporting:

- Fixed the issue where only certain items ("Scroll of Body", "Clump of Sugar", "Leaf Remedy (XL)") were produced when the Roulette was spun right after launching the game.
- Fixed the issue where the names of Kami arts shown on the weapon screen of the Coin Exchange were switched under certain circumstances.
- Corrected some typos.

notes.title: Eldgear confirmed to release on March 8th!
notes.notes:
The legacy of the magic civilization era ignites the flames of great turmoil! Authentic tactical SRPG "Eldgear" scheduled for release on 3/8! Wishlisting now open!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2541210/Eldgear/

The tactical SRPG that gained popularity on Japanese feature phones has undergone a complete character illustration renewal and is resurrected after 18 years! A genuine turn-based simulation RPG with over 25 stages. Seize victory by utilizing regular skills, two types of special skills, and over 10 characters!
